table.retrieve:
select   
	customercategory=customercategory.name,
	glheader.glvochcode,
	glheader.vouchercode,
	gldetail.debit,
	gldetail.credit, 
	date = glheader.date,
	type = 	RTRIM(LTRIM((SELECT V.SHORTNAME 
				FROM vochercategory v 
				WHERE v.vochcatcode = glheader.vochcatcode))) + '-' +		
		RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), glheader.glvochcode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = glheader.acccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = gldetail.acccode),
	invoicecode=gldetail.invoicecode,
	posted = glheader.posted
from
	glheader,
	gldetail,
	customer,
	customercategory
where    
	glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and
	gldetail.credit > 0 AND
	glheader.vochcatcode IN (2, 4, 12, 13) and glheader.acccode <> gldetail.acccode and 
	glheader.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND
	gldetail.acccode = customer.custcode and
	customer.custcatcode = customercategory.custcatcode and
	customercategory.custcatcode in (:ai_custcatcode)
union all
select   
	customercategory=customercategory.name,
	glvochcode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode,
	invoicecode=SaleLedger.HeaderInvNo,
	debit=0,
	credit=SaleLedger.amt, 
	date = SaleLedger.date,
	type = 'SV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), SaleLedger.SaleInvCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SaleLedger.PaymentAccCode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SaleLedger.CustCode),
	invoicecode=SaleLedger.SaleInvCode,
	posted = SaleLedger.posted
from
	SaleLedger,
	customer,
	customercategory
where    
	SaleLedger.amt <> 0 AND
	SaleLedger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate AND
	SaleLedger.custcode = customer.custcode and
	customer.custcatcode = customercategory.custcatcode and
	customercategory.custcatcode in (:ai_custcatcode)
order by
	customercategory,
	date,
	type,
	accountname,
	accounthead
table.sort: date A, type A, accountname A, accounthead A
